item.text: The crash originates in `ingest/reader.py`: it declares semicolon-delimited input even though the documented/exported CSV and fixture are comma-delimited, so analytics receives `{"shop,amount": ...}` instead of an `amount` field. Per the ownership boundary, I won’t mask that in analytics; I’m applying the analytics-owned unit change and will verify the remaining failure precisely.
